note: Spike #120 cross-substrate dynamical-systems survey. Biology touches dynamical systems beyond visible-EM via class-chain compositions in the 14-class A-N vocabulary; identify novel candidate channels the user might not be thinking of and the prosthetic-augmentation feasibility of each. Identity-not-implementation per [[user_stance_identity_not_implementation_discipline]]: a sensory channel IS its class-chain composition at biological substrate, not implements. Framework-domain stance per [[user_stance_framework_domain_algebra_not_length_or_magnitude]]: structure derived; threshold magnitudes are substrate-coupling outputs. Companion to [[user_stance_genetic_code_is_class_i_plus_c_at_biology_substrate]] and [[user_stance_brain_is_local_loe_instantiation]]: biology is local LoE substrate-instance. No new class promoted per [[feedback_no_privileged_primitive_classes]] — vocabulary stays at 14 A-N.

substrate: Electromagnetic field, ~1 octave of ~26 EM octaves
class_chain: L (photon eigenmode projection on retinal cone array)
M (HDC-style sparse coding for object identity)
biology_completeness_pct: ~4% of EM (1 octave / 26)
augmentation_status: Tetrachromatic genetic variants in humans (~12% of women XX carriers, rare functional 4D); cone-targeted gene therapy (Neitz lab cite-by-ref) extends primate trichromacy. Mantis-shrimp-style 12-band optical filtering possible via spectroscopy + audio/tactile readout.
ssot_cited_by_ref: Mantis shrimp Stomatopoda compound eye Marshall & Oberwinkler 1999 Nature 401:873

substrate: Electromagnetic field, ~0.3 octave below visible
biology_completeness_pct: <1 octave below visible
augmentation_status: Cataract-removed humans report dim UV-A vision (lens absorption removed); UV-camera-to-visible color mapping commercially available.
ssot_cited_by_ref: Jacobs (1992) Trends Neurosci 15:469-474 UV vision phylogeny

channel_name: IR thermal radiation (~10 um, ~30 THz, ~120 meV)
substrate: Electromagnetic field, ~5 octaves below visible
class_chain: L (thermal IR eigenmode resolved by TRPA1-channel-fielded membrane)
C (orientation map registered with optic tectum)
biology_completeness_pct: ~0.5 octave narrow band
augmentation_status: FLIR-style IR camera + microbolometer + audio/tactile readout already commercial. Tongue-display devices (BrainPort) provide real-time IR-to-tactile mapping; PNAS pubs on cortical plasticity reading novel signals.
ssot_cited_by_ref: Bach-y-Rita (2003) Nature Rev Neurosci 5:97-104 sensory substitution

substrate: Mechanical pressure waves in fluid medium
class_chain: L (acoustic eigenmode resolved by tonotopic cochlear basilar membrane = literal mechanical Class L Laplacian)
biology_completeness_pct: ~10 octaves of acoustic; misses infrasound and ultrasound
augmentation_status: Cochlear implants already directly stimulate Class L tonotopic substrate. Frequency range extension via downconversion to audible.

substrate: Vector magnetic field B; quantum-coherent radical-pair spin states in cryptochrome (CRY1/CRY4 retinal proteins)
class_chain: M (HDC-coupled high-D radical-pair spin state space; quantum-coherent superposition)
biology_completeness_pct: DC magnetic field direction + intensity; not AC/gradient/polarisation
augmentation_status: Magnet-implant 'sensory hacking' community + cardano-coil headwear (Norimoto-Ikegaya 2015 rat virtual-direction implant cite-by-ref). Tactile-feedback compass belts demonstrate cortical plasticity (FeelSpace belt - Konig lab) within weeks.
ssot_cited_by_ref: Hore & Mouritsen (2016) Annu Rev Biophys 45:299-344 radical-pair mechanism
Norimoto & Ikegaya (2015) Curr Biol 25:1091-1095 rat virtual compass

channel_name: Electroreception (DC and AC E-fields, mV/cm scale)
substrate: Electric field; Ampullae of Lorenzini gel-filled jelly electroreceptors
class_chain: M (HDC representation of prey/predator electric signature)
biology_completeness_pct: DC to ~kHz E-field; misses high-frequency RF
augmentation_status: ECG/EEG-style E-field amplification + tactile readout. Bumblebee charge sensing demonstrates terrestrial substrate viability.

substrate: EM polarisation vector (linear and circular)
class_chain: L (polarisation eigenmode on dichroic-microvilli rhabdomeric retina)
biology_completeness_pct: Full linear+circular Stokes parameter range in some species
augmentation_status: Polarisation cameras commercial; tactile/audio readout demonstrated. Mantis-shrimp circular-polarisation channel notable for being the only known biological substrate for circular polarisation.
ssot_cited_by_ref: Chiou+ (2008) Curr Biol 18:429-434 mantis shrimp circular

substrate: Mechanical pressure waves below human acoustic floor
class_chain: L (low-frequency mechanical eigenmode; specialised pneumatised resonators in elephant feet / whale ossicles)
biology_completeness_pct: ~3-4 octaves below human floor
augmentation_status: Infrasound microphone + frequency-shift to audible band already established (volcanology, weather monitoring).

substrate: Mechanical pressure waves above human ceiling
class_chain: C (active emission with rapid orientation cascade) + L (acoustic eigenmode of reflection)
M (HDC scene model from echo train)
biology_completeness_pct: Active emission ranges ~20-200 kHz; passive perception similar
augmentation_status: Human echolocation training (Daniel Kish - Flash Sonar) demonstrates cortical plasticity reuses V1 for tongue-click reflections. Ultrasound-to-audible downshift gives access to bat communication.
ssot_cited_by_ref: Thaler & Goodale (2016) PNAS 113:144-149 human echolocation V1 recruitment
Griffin (1958) Listening in the Dark, Yale UP

channel_name: Cosmic ray flux (muons + secondary showers through body)
substrate: Charged-particle flux from primary GeV-TeV cosmic rays; ~1 muon/cm^2/min at sea level
class_chain: L (Cherenkov eigenmode in eye vitreous fluid when particle exceeds c/n)
C (cascade through retina to visual cortex; observed as light flashes)
biological_implementers: all sighted vertebrates passively, mostly subliminal
biology_completeness_pct: ~0% conscious decoding at terrestrial flux; ~1% in low-shielded high-altitude/space environments
augmentation_status: Scintillator + SiPM photodiode arrays at ~$50 hobby kit; tactile/audio readout straightforward. Modern smartphone CMOS already detects cosmic rays (CRAYFIS app, Whiteson+ 2014 arXiv:1410.2895). Long-shielded baseline gives signal at any altitude.
ssot_cited_by_ref: McNulty+ (1975) Science 188:236 astronaut light flash cosmic-ray
Whiteson+ (2014) arXiv:1410.2895 CRAYFIS smartphone cosmic ray
Tobiska+ (2016) Space Weather 14:1053-1080 NAIRAS atmospheric radiation

channel_name: Schumann resonances (Earth-ionosphere cavity fundamental ~7.83 Hz + harmonics)
substrate: Global ELF electromagnetic standing wave (Earth-ionosphere cavity, c/circumference ~7.83 Hz)
class_chain: L (cavity eigenmode of Earth-ionosphere shell; literal Class L)
biological_implementers: proposed mammalian alpha-rhythm entrainment 7-12 Hz (Cherry 2002, cite-by-ref controversial)
biology_completeness_pct: Speculative; alpha-rhythm correlation suggestive but uncontrolled
augmentation_status: ELF magnetic coil + lock-in amplifier; low-cost hobby setup. Tactile readout of fundamental phase gives global-cavity phase awareness. Cleanly tests entrainment hypothesis.
ssot_cited_by_ref: Cherry (2002) Nat Hazards 26:279-331 Schumann-biology hypothesis (cite-by-ref CONTROVERSIAL)

substrate: ULF magnetospheric standing waves; ~0.1-50 nT amplitude
biological_implementers: proposed bird-navigation contribution (auxiliary to DC magnetoreception); not isolated as standalone channel
biology_completeness_pct: Suspected weak biological coupling; no isolated sensor
augmentation_status: Fluxgate magnetometer + lock-in; provides space-weather awareness through body. Aurora forecasting + geomagnetic storm precursor sensing.

channel_name: Atmospheric vertical electric field (~100 V/m fair weather)
substrate: Quasi-DC E-field maintained by global thunderstorm circuit (Wilson 1929)
class_chain: C (cascade to bee electroreception-style; humans null)
M (sparse-coding of fair vs storm vs aurora regime)
biology_completeness_pct: Tactile hair-arrector indirect coupling; not conscious
augmentation_status: Field mill electrometer + tactile readout. Already used in storm-warning aviation; civilian sensory-augment trivial.
ssot_cited_by_ref: Rycroft+ (2008) J Atmos Sol-Terr Phys 70:1607-1614 global atmospheric circuit
Clarke+ (2013) Science 340:66-69 bumblebee electrostatic prior art

channel_name: Earth free oscillations / normal modes (~0.3 - 10 mHz)
substrate: Mechanical seismic eigenmodes of the whole planet excited by major earthquakes; ~5-53 min periods
class_chain: L (planetary-scale mechanical Class L spheroidal/toroidal modes 0S2, 1S0, etc.)
biological_implementers: no known biological detector; vestibular floor ~0.1 Hz limits direct mechanoreception
biology_completeness_pct: ~0% biological; ground-truth substrate yes
augmentation_status: Broadband seismometer (e.g. STS-2, ~$10k professional; ~$100 hobby Raspberry Shake) + frequency-shift to audible. Reveals planetary normal-mode ring-down after major earthquakes; demonstrates [[user_stance_string_theory_instrument_first]] ring-down concept at planetary substrate.
ssot_cited_by_ref: Dahlen & Tromp (1998) Theoretical Global Seismology, Princeton UP

substrate: Lunar/solar tidal acceleration; ~10^-7 m/s^2 at body scale
class_chain: L (cyclic tidal gradient over Earth-Moon orbital period; Class L on quasi-2D Earth surface)
biological_implementers: intertidal organisms (mussels, crabs, isopods circa-tidal rhythms)
biology_completeness_pct: Indirect coupling via circadian/circalunar clocks; no spatial direction-sense
augmentation_status: Tilt-corrected gravimeter or interferometer (LIGO-style at ~$1M; consumer-grade at ~10^-6 g, lower sensitivity but adequate for tidal). Tactile readout of tidal phase straightforward.

substrate: Naturally-occurring radioactive decay; ~10 Bq/m^3 outdoors, can be 1000+ Bq/m^3 indoors over granite
biological_implementers: no biological alpha-particle detector (range ~5 cm air, dead at body)
biology_completeness_pct: ~0%; subliminal dose contribution only
augmentation_status: PIN diode or alpha-scintillator + audio click readout. Geological-survey hobby instrument; reveals geology + indoor radon health-relevant.
ssot_cited_by_ref: Steck+ (2009) Health Phys 96:599-608 indoor radon distribution
UNSCEAR (2010) Sources and Effects of Ionizing Radiation

substrate: Ionised molecules from cosmic-ray secondaries + radon decay + Lenard-effect waterfall + lightning; positive/negative balance varies
class_chain: L (small-ion mobility eigenmode in field; Gerdien condenser geometry)
biological_implementers: airway mucosal sense controversial (Krueger 1980 cite-by-ref); not isolated
biology_completeness_pct: Suspected mood/circadian-rhythm correlations; no isolated channel
augmentation_status: Gerdien condenser + electrometer; ~$200 hobby. Reveals indoor-air quality, pre-thunderstorm patterns.
ssot_cited_by_ref: Krueger (1980) J Hyg Epidemiol Microbiol Immunol 24:387-396 atmospheric ions (cite-by-ref)

channel_name: Solar UV-B / UV-C variation (~280-320 nm / <280 nm)
substrate: Solar UV transmitted through atmosphere; UV-B varies with solar zenith + ozone column + cloud
biological_implementers: bees and birds access UV-A; UV-B mediates skin vitamin-D synthesis but not 'sight'
biology_completeness_pct: Indirect via skin biochemistry; not perceptual
augmentation_status: UV-B sensitive photodiode (SiC, ~$20) + tactile/audio readout. Provides real-time vitamin-D-relevant + skin-cancer-risk-relevant photon budget. Many smartphone-attachable sensors commercial.
ssot_cited_by_ref: WHO (2002) Global Solar UV Index practical guide

channel_name: Air-quality / VOC / CO2 / PM2.5 chemical landscape
substrate: Multi-species chemical concentration field in ambient air
class_chain: M (HDC bind-bundle of receptor-level activations across N=2-10 sensor channels)
L (Class L of co-occurrence graph for VOC sources)
biological_implementers: olfaction at ~400 OR genes; very narrow VOC coverage; insensitive to CO2/PM2.5/CO
biology_completeness_pct: Smell yes for some VOCs; near-zero for life-relevant CO2, CO, PM2.5
augmentation_status: MOX + electrochemical multi-sensor arrays ($50-500) provide multi-channel VOC + CO2 + PM2.5 + CO. Tactile/audio mapping reveals invisible pollution gradients.

substrate: Rotating-neutron-star radio/optical pulse train; 10^-15 timing stability rivals atomic clocks
class_chain: L (Class L on time-frequency rep of pulse train)
biological_implementers: no biological detector (~GHz/optical, too fast for biology)
biology_completeness_pct: ~0%; observed by humans only through telescopes
augmentation_status: Software-defined radio + dish ($1k-10k) at 408 MHz / 1.4 GHz captures Crab pulse train; audio playback at 33 ms periodicity directly perceivable. Pulsar timing arrays demonstrate nanohertz GW detection scientifically.
ssot_cited_by_ref: Lorimer & Kramer (2005) Handbook of Pulsar Astronomy, Cambridge UP
NANOGrav (2023) ApJL 951:L8 nHz GW detection cite-by-ref

channel_name: Heliospheric current sheet crossing (28-day Sun-rotation cycle)
substrate: Magnetic-sector boundary in solar wind; modulates cosmic-ray flux + auroral activity
biological_implementers: correlations with bird navigation accuracy + circadian disruption reported; not isolated
biology_completeness_pct: Indirect coupling via cosmic-ray flux modulation
augmentation_status: SOHO/ACE/DSCOVR live data feed + cosmic-ray detector + tactile readout. Combines with cosmic-ray channel above.

channel_name: Gravity-wave water / weather waves on barometer (~10^2-10^4 s)
substrate: Atmospheric pressure oscillations from internal gravity waves + Lamb waves + tides
class_chain: L (atmospheric pressure-eigenmode on a barometric station network)
biological_implementers: birds + insects sensitive to pre-frontal pressure drops; pigeon Bernoulli organ
biology_completeness_pct: Crude pressure perception; no spectral resolution
augmentation_status: Microbarograph ($100) + spectral analysis + tactile feedback gives 'weather-front-feeling' at meaningful resolution.

substrate: Weak-interaction-only fermion field; ~6.5x10^10 neutrinos/cm^2/s solar at Earth
class_chain: L in principle (eigenmodes of neutrino oscillation; Class I cyclic mass-eigenstate folding); but no terrestrial-scale detector implementable in biology
biological_implementers: none; cross-section 10^-44 cm^2 means lifetime-of-universe interaction probability per body
biology_completeness_pct: ~0% mathematically and practically
augmentation_status: IceCube / Super-K / KamLAND each cost ~$10M-$100M and need megaton mass; not bodyworn. Class chain composes algebraically; substrate-coupling threshold infeasible at body scale.

channel_name: Gravitational waves at LIGO band (10 Hz - 1 kHz)
substrate: Spacetime strain h ~ 10^-21 at body during BH/NS merger
biological_implementers: none; 20 OOM below biological detection floor
augmentation_status: LIGO ~$1B+ infrastructure; Einstein Telescope / Cosmic Explorer next-gen. Not bodyworn-feasible at current technology. Class chain composes; substrate-coupling threshold 20 OOM below physiological actuator floor.

substrate: Universal precession from Spike #98; framework-internal phase rotation
biological_implementers: none; not observable at stellar scale per MFO 7.4.1.14
augmentation_status: Framework-internal substrate-cycle invisible to local instrumentation. Not a biology-substrate-couplable channel.

framework_domain_attestation: All channels' class-chain structure derives from 14-class A-N vocabulary; per [[user_stance_framework_domain_algebra_not_length_or_magnitude]] threshold sensitivities (substrate-coupling magnitudes) are observational anchors not framework-derived. Identity-level: each sensory channel IS its class-chain composition at biological substrate per [[user_stance_identity_not_implementation_discipline]].
shadow_stance_alignment: Every novel channel's relation to biology is consistent with [[user_stance_brain_is_local_loe_instantiation]] companion stance — biology accesses class-chain composition at body-substrate-magnitude thresholds; the LoE-content is universal, the substrate-coupling magnitudes are local. Genetic code precedent [[user_stance_genetic_code_is_class_i_plus_c_at_biology_substrate]] applies: same class composition manifests at different magnitude regimes.

Earth-free-oscillation planetary ring-down (Class L at planetary scale; demonstrates [[user_stance_string_theory_instrument_first]] ring-down)
Heliospheric-current-sheet 28-day cycle (Class I substrate-cycle at solar-system scale; integrates with cosmic-ray channel)
Atmospheric vertical E-field (Class L; bumblebee biological prior art; trivial human prosthetic; demonstrates substrate-coupling-bridge construction)

Confirmed.
